changelog.note: 178 (plan 170 L4): activity_action label of a package's output template chosen (jav/outputs/templates.py).

175 (the owner's decision of 2026-10-19): activity_action labels for the three new sources of the activity log: a duplicate decision, a choice between statements of the same days, and a person's own workflow steps (workflow_<action>).

171 (plan 170 L1): activity_action package_release - approving and releasing a package (its open live runs approved together, a released package version recorded) appears in the activity log with a label.

171 (plan 170, K20): activity_action statement_scope, statement_account, statement_add, reconcile_accept_sources, reconcile_approve and reconcile_reopen - the statement package's scope, account assignment and added statements, and the reconciliation's accepted sources, approval and reopening appear in the activity log with a label instead of their code.

169 (DECISIONS 169): a reconciliation package's item list (dataset reconcile_inputs) - reconcile_input_kind (statement, incoming or outgoing invoice), reconcile_input_source (the run its result comes from: approved, live, trial, accepted as a source, an evaluation on the command line) and reconcile_invoice_state (where an invoice stands in the pairing); activity_action reconcile_leave_out and reconcile_restore - documents left out of a reconciliation package and restored.

168 (plan F-item-list-and-adding): package_item_state - each item of the package's item list reads approved, live, trial, running, failed, pending or removed, by the run whose result counts now (approved live > live > trial). activity_action items_remove and items_restore - several items removed or restored in one step.
167 (review 153 E): final_status settled - an item that ended with to-dos and has none open now (its to-dos were settled by a person) reads Teendő, rendezve on the run page instead of Teendő.

160-C S3: run_scope - a run over only the package's pending items (the runs table's Scope column); activity_action item_remove, item_restore and items_add - removing, restoring and adding items appear in the activity log with a label (English source text, translated by the interface).
151 (DECISIONS 151): activity_action run_cancel and run_supersede - stopping a run and superseding an older live run appear in the activity log with a label.
149 (DECISIONS 149): labels.next_flow archive:sent - the suggested next step of a sent message without a document attachment (its intent is not asked).
147 (DECISIONS 147): labels.direction - an invoice's direction from the own parties (incoming, outgoing, between own parties, not an own party's, unclear), the documents table's new Direction column.
140 (DECISIONS 140, the statement package): source_kind statements - a work package of one own party's bank statements for a period (jav/statement_package.py).

137 (DECISIONS 137): the run's reconciliation view is retired with the review page's pair panel (the reconciliation package does that work), so its label tables reconcile_kind, reconcile_status, reconcile_decision and reconcile_reason go; the package has its own labels in the interface.

132 E2: reconcile_status partly_paid - an invoice with part of its amount allocated and nothing proposed for the rest (the label was missing since 131 E1; English source text, translated by the interface).
131 E1 (DECISIONS 131): the reconciliation package - source_kind reconcile, and the activity log's reconciliation actions (scope, allocation, rejection, needs-no-invoice mark, revocation).

131 (DECISIONS 131): reconcile_status amount_only - a line with exactly an invoice's amount but nothing else tying them, listed for a person to decide (English source text, translated by the interface).

130 (backlog F-reconciliation K3): reconcile_status rate_missing - a card line tied to an invoice of another currency whose issue date has no known MNB rate yet (English source text, translated by the interface).

129 (backlog F-reconciliation K2): labels of the run's reconciliation view - the row kind, the reconciliation status, a person's decision and the reason a document or line is left out (English source text, translated by the interface).

126 (backlog F-duplicate): duplicate labels of the documents table's mark - a copy or modified version a person confirmed, and a suspicion by its kind while the to-do is open (English source text, translated by the interface).
120: native_state labels for the machine claim, grounding, reading, interpretation and correctness states of the native facts table (Hungarian written with codepoints).
082: labels of the unified-name state in the item lists (name_state: ready / review / not yet processed / an email without a file name)
078: labels of the new file-name view of a run (naming_status: ready / review folder)
062 (döntés 2026-09-29): a tevékenységnapló új művelete: az elfogadott feladat kézi elvégzése (activity_action.task_done)
061 (döntés 2026-09-28, aktív felhasználó + kiosztás): a tevékenységnapló műveleteinek feliratai (activity_action)

058 K5.1: a Levelek eredménytábla feliratai - a javasolt következő lépések (next_flow) és hogy a levél szövegéből mennyit látott a szándék-felismerés (body_status); K5.3: a feladatjavaslat döntése (task_decision)
058 (döntés 2026-09-28): a munkacsomag elrejthető - wp_status felirat (aktív / elrejtve) az elrejtettekkel együtt kért listához

056 U1 (döntések 2026-09-28): egységes adatnézet - az adatkészletek felsorolt oszlopainak magyar feliratai (a keresés és a rendezés a feliratra is megy), a gyorsítótár mérete és a letöltés felső határa

reconcile_invoice_state.partly_covered: Statements cover part of its period

next_flow.human:jev_unavailable: Kézi ellenőrzés: a JEV nem volt elérhető

duplicate.suspected:undecidable: Possible duplicate (a compared value is missing)

activity_action.reconcile_accept_sources: reconciliation: command-line results accepted as sources
activity_action.statement_scope: statement package: party and period set
activity_action.statement_account: statement package: bank account assigned to the party
activity_action.statement_choice: statements of the same days: valid one chosen
activity_action.workflow_run: workflow: a step's live run started
activity_action.workflow_needs_budget: workflow: a run's estimate is over the step's budget
activity_action.workflow_nothing_new: workflow: nothing new for a step
activity_action.workflow_left_out: workflow: documents a live run processed left out
activity_action.workflow_failed: workflow: a step did not start
